info.name: GPU Sound 2: Il volo del calabrone (Piano)
info.description: Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's 'Il volo del calabrone' (Flight of the Bumblebee) arranged for Piano by Sergei Rachmaninoff (熊蜂の飛行), synthesized in real-time on the GPU via PassType.sound.

renderpass.name: Common
renderpass.description: Shared musical score patterns, pitch mapping, and score constants for Flight of the Bumblebee.

renderpass.name: Image
renderpass.description: Visual stage showcasing the looping golden flight trajectory of the bumblebee.

renderpass.name: Sound
renderpass.description: Physical-modeling concert grand piano synthesis of the complete 104-measure score of Rimsky-Korsakov's Flight of the Bumblebee (arr. Rachmaninoff).
